column5: Ah, there you are. / Your dedicated work in my LAB / has been much appreciated. / And now, your fieldwork / assignment is about to begin.
As you know, at the heart of / my research is the relationship / between POKéMON and people...
...How they grow together / through trust, battle, / friendship... / Even evolution may be shaped / by those bonds.

But to understand this, you / need to go where they live. / The towns, forests, caves, / shorelines, and old ruins. / I am too old for fieldwork now, / but you are just the right age / for this expedition.
Now tell me for your / FIELD AIDE record.
Are you a boy or a girl?
And how do you spell / your name?
Right… / AAAAAAA.
This is my grandson. / Like you, he has been helping / with my research here in / PALLET TOWN. / His name is...
His name is AAAAAAA?
Yes. / His name is AAAAAAA. /
AAAAAAA! / KANTO is waiting beyond the LAB. / Observe carefully, learn directly, / and trust the POKéMON at your side. / Your fieldwork begins now.

OAK: Pay attention to how the / GYM LEADERS treat their POKéMON. / There is more to learn than / strength alone. / I also study rare POKéMON whose / instincts exceed ordinary limits. / I call them APEX POKéMON. / Listen to local accounts and / compare three in your LOGBOOK. / Together, they may reveal where / an APEX POKéMON can be found. / Be ready before you challenge one. / If you flee from its battle, / it will leave for good.
AAAAAAA played with the NES. / …Okay! / It’s time to go!

AAAAAAA: Hah! / Took you long enough, AAAAAAA. / I already checked DIGLETT’S CAVE. / Obviously. / People around here keep whining / that the MR. MIME vanished. / One guy even says they put up / invisible walls to avoid training. / Sounds fake... / which means Gramps will want it / written down. / So listen carefully for once. / Compare three local accounts / in your LOGBOOK. / Work out where they point. / That is where you investigate. / Try not to make me explain / fieldwork twice. / Smell ya later.
AAAAAAA played with the NES. / …Okay! / It’s time to go!
My father once told me he / ventured deep into VIRIDIAN / FOREST. / He heard the grumbling growls of / a shadowy figure lurking within.
AAAAAAA played with the NES. / …Okay! / It’s time to go!
I’m too scared to enter / VIRIDIAN FOREST. / Legends tell of the forest / coming alive and ensnaring the / wicked, never to be seen again.
The flowers in VIRIDIAN FOREST / are so beautiful. / They seem more vibrant and grow / in number the closer you get to / the centre of the forest. / Almost like something is drawing / them inward.
OAK: The POKéDEX signal was / almost swallowed by the forest. / So the old stories were not just / stories. / TANGROWTH may be instinct / given root and vine.
There’s something furious and / hurt deep within this cave. / I can feel it losing control. / Maybe I should head home.
An enormous POKéMON barged in / through the wall! / It was shaking with rage. / Completely unstoppable! / Lucky for us, it rampaged out / the door and headed west, / toward MT. MOON.
A hulking PRIMEAPE fled in a / blind rage and took refuge / inside MT. MOON. / It was out of control, like its / feelings had boiled over! / I’ve never seen one get that / big before!
OAK: The POKéDEX recorded extreme / emotional force. / ANNIHILAPE shows what happens / when feeling outruns control. / Be careful with such power.

Well, isn’t this a surprise! / MR. MIME have made themselves / a little home together in / DIGLETT CAVE. / They seem intent on keeping it / all to themselves. / It leads all the way to PEWTER / CITY, wouldn’t you know!
The MR. MIME went into DIGLETT / CAVE and erected barriers. / It’s like they built their own / little community and closed the / world out.
This DIGLETT CAVE extends all / the way to VERMILION CITY. / Watch out for invisible walls / though! / Feels like something in there / doesn’t want visitors.
OAK: Fascinating. The barriers / registered as a social pattern. / MIME SR. seems to protect its / group. / It turns isolation into / structure.
I took this CUBONE away from / its mother. / Now it won’t even train with me! / Bad investment.
CUBONE: Kyoo! / It keeps crying and looking / around, as if searching for / someone.
It’s said that inside POKéMON / TOWER is a vengeful spirit. / It howls in anger over the / family it lost.
The tower carries the grief of / families torn apart. / Some say one spirit still waits / above, calling for the family it / lost.
OAK: I received the tower record. / OSSCYTHE’s readings are bound to / grief and memory. / Loss can shape a life as surely / as evolution.
When storms pass over the POWER / PLANT, the river keeps buzzing. / It’s like nature is feeding it / power without end.
Even when the generators quiet / down, the air still crackles. / It feels like the power is coming / from the sky itself.
I saw lightning gather here / without a cloud overhead. / No battery can hold power like / that. It just keeps coming.
OAK: Extraordinary! That power / reading did not fade after battle. / ZAPDOS seems less like stored / electricity. / It is more like a source / that renews itself.
SEAFOAM ISLANDS used to be / volcanic just like CINNABAR / ISLAND. / Then one day it all changed at / once, and now it’s as cold as / ice!
You broke me into pieces too! / SEAFOAM was split by a sudden / freeze. The caves still hold / that cold.
Can you believe this whole area / used to be flooded with lava? / One sudden change, and the / whole cave became something else. / The deeper you go, the sharper / the cold gets.
OAK: Your readings show a sudden / collapse in temperature. / ARTICUNO changes an environment / all at once. / Adaptation under pressure... / remarkable.
After each eruption, the volcano / leaves new soil behind. / Plants return stronger than before. / Nature renews itself through fire.
Our lab studies how fire can / restore as well as consume. / There are reports of MOLTRES / stirring life back into scorched / volcanic earth.
Fire-types love this pressure. / Down here, even burned ground / feels alive again. / Like the volcano keeps renewing / its own energy.
OAK: Those volcanic readings are / alive with renewal. / MOLTRES does not only burn. / It returns spent energy / to the world.
????: Empty… / After all these years, empty. / MEWTWO was perfect power. / Power without waste. / Power without weakness.

MEWTWO broke free before that / power could be claimed. / No matter. / I built that power once. / I will retrieve it, perfect it, / and make it mine. / SILPH in SAFFRON has what I need. / A BALL that cannot fail.
PRESIDENT: GIOVANNI, stop this! / The MASTER BALL was never meant / to enslave POKEMON. / If you force that power on MEWTWO, / you’ll bring ruin on us all.

GIOVANNI: You’re the child from / POKEMON MANSION... / So, you followed me from / CINNABAR ISLAND. / SILPH’s MASTER BALL is no mere / product. / It is control made mechanical. / Command made perfect. / With its plans, TEAM ROCKET will / manufacture the means to reclaim / MEWTWO. / Come forth. / I’ll deal with you now.

GIOVANNI: So SILPH’s MASTER BALL / will remain out of reach. / No matter. / A BALL is only one way to claim / power. / SILPH’s signal research will / complete my device. / I will call MEWTWO to ROUTE 7. / Once it answers, no LEAGUE, / no child, and no bond will stand / in my way. / TEAM ROCKET, withdraw. / We have what we need.

PRESIDENT: Oh, dear boy! / Thank you for saving SILPH. / GIOVANNI failed to take the / MASTER BALL plans. / But before he fled, he accessed / our signal research. / If he combines it with old / CINNABAR records, he may force / MEWTWO to respond. / Please, take this. / If he reaches MEWTWO, you may / need it.

PRESIDENT: You can’t buy that / anywhere. / It’s our secret prototype MASTER / BALL. / It was built to catch any POKéMON / without fail. / But a capture is only a beginning. / It cannot make a POKéMON trust / you. That part is up to you.

GIOVANNI: So that is the difference. / I tried to possess MEWTWO. / You faced it as a TRAINER. / Perhaps absolute power was never / something a person could own. / There is nothing left for me / to take from this place. / I will return to VIRIDIAN GYM.

GIOVANNI: Gone. / Neither of us could hold it here. / Perhaps absolute power was never / something a person could own. / There is nothing left for me / to take from this place. / I will return to VIRIDIAN GYM.
OAK: The POKéDEX is struggling / to classify that presence. / MEWTWO’s power is not natural / instinct alone. / It is a question we created / but do not understand.

AGATHA: GIOVANNI thought / control was the same as / trust. / Always the same mistake.
GIOVANNI: MEWTWO. / Again. / Obey.
AGATHA: Hah. / Hear that silence? / It is already choosing / whether to listen.
GIOVANNI: The signal / still holds. / MEWTWO obeys me.
GIOVANNI: Then strike her.
AGATHA: Not for long.
AGATHA: He learned nothing. / MEWTWO learned faster. / LANCE followed them into the / cave opened by MEWTWO’s blast.
LORELEI: You’re late. / We all were. / MEWTWO tore through here / under GIOVANNI’s command...
GIOVANNI: MEWTWO. / Destroy the ELITE FOUR. / Show them perfected power.
LORELEI: MEWTWO! / Stop!
GIOVANNI: The signal holds. / Fire.
LORELEI: That is what I saw. / Power without trust only / becomes another storm.
BRUNO: I met MEWTWO head-on. / Foolish. / It pushed through me like / I was mist.
BRUNO: Hah! / Then strike me!
BRUNO: I felt no discipline / in that power. / Only pressure.
LANCE: I followed GIOVANNI / and MEWTWO into this cave, / opened by MEWTWO’s blast. / GIOVANNI’s signal was / breaking. / MEWTWO was beginning to / choose for itself.
GIOVANNI: The signal / still holds. / MEWTWO, return to me.
MEWTWO: GYAAOOO! / LANCE: It’s rejecting / his control!
GIOVANNI: MEWTWO! / You will not escape me. / Not again!
